paragraphs.text: O Doeg, who half consider to be the tyrant Saul, and had the power to murder the saints of God.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Your malice moves you by crafty flattery and lies to accuse and destroy the innocents.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Though God forbear for a time, yet at length he will recompense your falsehood.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Even though you seem to be never so sure settled.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: root thee out of the land

paragraphs.text: For the eyes of the reprobate are shut at God's judgments.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: With joyful reverence, seeing that he takes their part against the wicked.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: He rejoices to have a place among the servant's of God, that he may grow in the knowledge of godliness.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: green olive tree in the house
